FR:

{{TAG:0005:0001:}}saurus Rex !

ES:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Ay{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Yo esperaba ver más fósiles,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Si la cosa sigue así, ¡voy a

FR:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Oh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est vraiment dommage qu'il
y ait aussi peu de fossiles exposés
ici, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Faudra pas s'étonner si les visiteurs

IT:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Oh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Speravo di vedere molti
più fossili, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Questa collezione cresce a passo

io un fossile!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000A:}}Oh{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich hätte gern noch ein paar
Fossilien gesehen, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Wenn die ihre Sammlung weiter so

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}The collection here is simply

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡La colección de este sitio es

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Quelle superbe collection ! On se
croirait de retour dans la
préhistoire !
Enfin{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0002:}}À deux trois détails près !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Questa collezione è super! Ci sono
fossili ovunque!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Die Sammlung ist einfach
Weltklasse! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Die haben hier Fossilien,
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}so weit das Auge reicht!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}This is like a dreamland where we

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}¡Esto es como un lugar de ensueño

cualquier fósil que te interese!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}¡Oooh! ¡Esto es una locura!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Cet endroit, c'est le paradis des
collectionneurs de fossiles !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ohhh !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} C'est vraiment trop, trop
cool !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Qu'est-ce que j'aimerais
pouvoir vivre ici !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Sembra di essere a Fossilandia.
Ci sono così tanti esemplari!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Ohhh! Voglio vivere qui dentro!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:001F:}}Ein Paradies für Dinofans!
{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Die haben alle möglichen

{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Omannomannomann! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Am liebsten

{{TAG:0003:0004:}}Burası türlü türlü havalı fosil

Bu çılgınlık! Keşke burada yaşayabilsem!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}If I had encountered dinosaurs when
they were alive{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}I bet we would
have been good rivals!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}J'aurais bien aimé pouvoir me
mesurer au combat de pouce contre
un iguanodon{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Mais malheureusement, ils n'existent
plus de nos jours{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Se fossi vissuto quando c'erano
i dinosauri{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} avrei usato i miei
muscoli per metterli tutti K.O.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Stell dir nur mal vor, was wäre,
wenn die Dinos hier noch leben
würden{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
Es gäb hammer-epische Duelle
zwischen den Dinos und mir!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Eventually, I plan on getting as
big as a dinosaur. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}So say hello to a
future fossil!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Algún día espero poder ser tan
grande y fuertote como un
dinosaurio.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}} ¡Soy un fósil del futuro!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Un jour, je deviendrai aussi baraqué
qu'un dinosaure. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Et moi aussi, je
finirai exposé dans un musée !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Prima o poi sarò grande come
un dinosauro. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Mi esporranno qui e
sarò il fossile più muscoloso di tutti!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Irgendwann werd ich so groß sein
wie ein Dino! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0021:}}Ich bin ein Riesenfossil

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bir gün dinozor kadar iri olmayı

fosiline selam ver!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}This is really awesome{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Dinosaurs
are so big and strong looking! I hope
to be one someday!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Esto es una pasada{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} ¡Qué grandes
y qué cachas debían de ser los
dinosaurios! ¡Me gustaría ser así!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Cet endroit est géant{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} À l'image
des dinosaures exposés ici !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}J'espère qu'un jour, je deviendrai
aussi grand et fort qu'eux !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Che meraviglia{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} I dinosauri sono
così grandi e forti! Spero proprio
di diventare come loro, un giorno.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Bu gerçekten müthiş{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}} Dinozorlar
ne kadar büyük ve güçlü görünüyor! Bir gün
ben de öyle olmak istiyorum!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}It must have been quite a chore to
polish these fossils!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Oh! And they probably had to be
really careful not to break anything!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}¡Tiene que haber sido un rollazo
quitarles la tierra a estos fósiles!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}¡Ah! ¡Y encima habrán tenido que
ir con muchísimo cuidado para
no romper ningún huesecillo!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Ça a dû prendre une éternité pour
dépoussiérer tous ces fossiles !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Sans parler de la concentration que
ça a dû demander pour ne rien
abîmer !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Deve essere una faticata pulire
tutti questi fossili!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Oh! Chissà quanti ne avranno rotti!
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ah ah ah! Tanto nessuno noterebbe
la differenza!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Bu fosilleri parlatmak bayağı iş
olmuştur!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Ah! Bir şeyi kırmamak için
de çok dikkat etmişlerdir!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}I bet some of these turned into
fossils{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} while being out and about
just like you are now!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Huy, tú y yo estamos aquí hablando
tan tranquilos, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}pero quizá algún día
acabemos expuestos en un museo...

{{TAG:0003:0012:}}Il paraît que tous les dinosaures
sont devenus des fossiles à cause

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Mais perso,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} j'ai du mal à
comprendre le rapport{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Sono sicuro che se ci si annoia
tanto,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ci si trasforma subito
in un fossile!

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Bence bunlardan bazıları{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} senin şimdi
gezdiğin gibi gezerken
fosile dönüşmüştür!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}They say if you find a new type of
fossil, you'll get to name that
dinosaur!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}If I were to name one, it would be
Super {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0001:}}-a-Saurus!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}That's the perfect name for the
strongest dinosaur, don't you think?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dicen que si descubres algún tipo
nuevo de fósil, ¡puedes ponerle
nombre a ese dinosaurio!
{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Si yo le pusiera nombre
a alguno, ¡lo llamaría el
Súper {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0001:}}-saurio!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Sería un nombre perfecto para
el dinosaurio más fuerte de
todos, ¿no crees?

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Il paraît que celui qui découvre une
nouvelle espèce de dinosaure a le
droit de lui donner son nom !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Si un jour j'en découvre un, je
l'appellerai :
{{TAG:000E:000A:06006C006500200004006C002700}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0001:}}-o-nosaure !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Avec un nom comme ça, il a intérêt

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ho sentito che puoi dare il nome

{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Io già so che nome darei:
Super-mega-{{TAG:0005:0001:}}rex!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Non vedo l'ora di usarlo!

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich hab mal gehört, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}dass man 'nem
Dino seinen Namen aussuchen darf,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
wenn man sein Fossil entdeckt hat!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Wenn ich's tun könnte,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} würde ich ihn
„Tyrannosaurus {{TAG:0005:0001:}}“ nennen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Ist doch ein passender Name für den
stärksten Dino aller Zeiten, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}oder?

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yeni bir fosil türü bulursan o dinozora
sen isim veriyormuşsun!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0006:}}Ben isim
